name: Mini World
description: Seen from above, the whole plaza around the subject turns into a tilt-shift toy miniature.

wardrobe.man: a bright yellow raincoat and dark trousers
wardrobe.woman: a bright yellow raincoat and dark trousers
wardrobe.person: a bright yellow raincoat and dark trousers

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. {references} The {subject} is the only person in the new still, with exactly {their} face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline, hairstyle, hair colour{facial_hair}, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. The clothing, the place and the light come only from this description. The {subject} stands in the middle of a large stone city plaza on a sunny morning, looking up toward the camera, wearing {wardrobe}. A fountain sits behind {them}, rows of trees line the plaza, a few small figures cross it, and cars move along the streets around it. High-angle wide shot from the height of a fourth-floor balcony, the {subject} centered and small in the frame. Cinematic photography, bright morning sun from the left, crisp shadows, saturated colors. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, plain facades and unbranded cars throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY stands in the plaza looking up at the camera. The whole scene turns into a handmade tilt-shift miniature: a band of sharp focus stays on the {subject} while the top and the bottom of the frame melt into soft blur, the colors grow saturated and toy-like, the trees become little model trees, the cars become toy cars that zip around the plaza in fast motion and the people become tiny painted figures, and the {subject} waves up at the camera as if from inside a diorama. The camera rises slowly and tilts down further. Sound: a tiny tinkling music-box chime, fast toy-car whirs, a soft breeze. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, tilt-shift miniature look with a shallow focus band, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The whole scene turns into a handmade tilt-shift miniature: a band of sharp focus stays on the {subject} while the top and the bottom of the frame melt into soft blur, the colors grow saturated and toy-like, and everything else moves in quick toy-like fast motion while the {subject} moves at normal speed. The camera keeps the same framing and the same movement it already has. Sound: a tiny tinkling chime, fast toy-like whirs. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, tilt-shift miniature look with a shallow focus band, sharp detail, stable picture.
